title: OUF Canonical Data Envelope v1
description: Stable internal contract between Connector/Adapter and the Ingestion processing pipeline. The source-specific payload remains under 'data' and does not become the OUF canonical Urban Object model.

envelopeVersion.description: Envelope contract version for this schema artifact. Ingestion Runtime v1.2 defines baseline 1.0 and requires unsupported major versions to be rejected before processing.

ingestionId.description: Stable identity of the acquired unit.

runId.description: Ingestion run that produced the envelope.

typeCode.description: Native source type. Required by the PET when applicable.

sourceObjectId.description: Technical source-object identity for record envelopes. It is not an UrbanObjectId. The PET requires it for records but does not define a machine-checkable discriminator for all possible non-record envelopes.

sourceSchemaId.description: Identifier of the observed/approved native source schema.

sourceSchemaVersion.description: Pinned source schema version; never inferred from the payload.

configurationBundleId.description: Identifier of the pinned PublishedConfigurationBundle used by the run.

configurationBundleVersion.description: Pinned bundle version used by the run.

operation.description: Envelope operation as frozen by Ingestion Runtime v1.2.

observedAt.description: UTC observation/event timestamp carried by the envelope.

acquiredAt.description: UTC acquisition timestamp assigned by OUF.

contentType.description: Media/content type of the adapted payload.

data.description: Conditional source-native or adapted payload limited to fields admitted by the active configuration. Its business shape remains source-specific and is intentionally not modeled here as the OUF Urban Object.

sourceDataRef.description: Optional durable reference form allowed by the compatibility freeze for payload/sourceData. Included without defining a storage URI scheme.

routeRef.description: Non-secret governed route/binding reference when applicable.

provenance.description: Non-secret correlation and acquisition provenance. The PET explicitly mentions correlation, route, page/change-token references but does not freeze a broader field list.

extensions.description: Optional additive extension area. Namespace/naming is governed; the PET does not define a concrete machine-enforceable namespace syntax, so this schema does not invent one.

x-ouf-compatibility.consumerRule: Consumers ignore unknown optional fields in major v1 and reject unsupported major versions.
x-ouf-compatibility.breakingRule: Removal or semantic change of a required field requires a new major.

x-ouf-scope-control: Only Canonical Data Envelope v1 is reconciled in this revision. This does not change HandoffPayload, LineageRecord, Candidate Canonical Object, transformation/mapping schemas, source-provider contracts or UDP DTOs.
